title: Naturality of homotopy-colimit maps in the value diagram
statement:
Use the model-category, universe, homotopy-colimit and canonical reindexing conventions of [lem-coef-hocolim-reindexing-zigzags]. Let $\mathcal M$ be a combinatorial model category, let $K$ and $J$ be small ordinary categories, and let $g:J\to K$ be a functor. For diagrams $F,G:K\to\mathcal M$ and an objectwise weak-equivalence natural transformation $\eta:F\to G$, choose the functorial projective cofibrant replacements used to define $\operatorname{hocolim}$ and let $H_K(\eta):\operatorname{hocolim}_K F\to\operatorname{hocolim}_K G$ be the induced map. The canonical reindexing comparisons satisfy
$$H_K(\eta)\,g_*^F=g_*^G\,H_J(\eta g),$$
in the homotopy category. If $\eta g$ is the identity transformation, this reduces to $H_K(\eta)g_*^F=g_*^G$.

source.place: Dugger, Combinatorial Model Categories Have Presentations, Appendix A.2 and Remark A.3(i)-(iv), printed pp. 197-198; agent-extracted value-diagram naturality of the canonical comparison, via projective replacement and the localized colimit universal property. No Stacks tag states this model-category assertion. Read online; not archived in literature/.
